evals.prompt: I just spun up a blank Figma file for a new SaaS analytics dashboard I'm building. Want a clean, trustworthy color system (probably blue-based) and a solid type scale — nothing fancy, just enough to start designing real screens today. No dark mode needed for now.
evals.expected_output: A two-tier color schema (primitives + semantic aliases), a semantic type scale, an HTML preview, and a filled-in Figma plugin (Path A) ready to create the tokens — with reasonable stated assumptions in place of unanswerable clarifying questions.

evals.prompt: Can you pull the color and typography feel from stripe.com and set up a matching token system for a fintech side project I'm starting? Needs to hit WCAG AA.
evals.expected_output: Same deliverable shape as eval 0, but color/type direction should visibly reflect stripe.com's actual palette/typography rather than a generic blue system, and every semantic text/background pairing must meet WCAG AA (4.5:1) since that was explicitly requested.

evals.prompt: Here's a screenshot of an app whose look I like — build me a color + type system based on it for a blank Figma file.
evals.expected_output: Same deliverable shape, with color/type direction plausibly derived from the screenshot's actual UI (not a generic default), and explicit hedging that extracted values are approximations, not exact source values. Requires attaching a real screenshot image when running this eval.

assertion_notes.token_schema_valid_json: Token schema is valid, well-structured JSON
assertion_notes.semantic_aliases_resolve: Every semantic color alias resolves to a real primitive
assertion_notes.contrast_meets_target: Semantic text/background pairings verifiably meet the accessibility target (via scripts/color_tools.py check-contrast)
assertion_notes.figma_plugin_deliverable_produced: A concrete Figma-side creation artifact was produced, not just a description
assertion_notes.variable_scopes_set_explicitly: Variable scopes are set explicitly, not left at Figma's ALL_SCOPES default
assertion_notes.text_style_uses_valid_style_field: Text styles use a real Figma style name (string, e.g. "Semi Bold"), not a bare numeric weight
assertion_notes.color_values_include_alpha: COLOR variable values include an alpha channel ({r,g,b,a}), which Figma's Variables API requires
